result.topic_en: Gauss determines the coefficients Q and Q' in the expansions of the theta-type products (x,y)^3 and (x,y)(x,-y)^2 by substituting y = -εx (ε a cube root of unity), expressing them via infinite products [x^n].
result.transcription:
232 \quad Litt: W.
Durch die Entwickelung von $(x,y)^3$ erhält man
$P\left(1+x^3(y^3+\frac{1}{y^3})+\quad\right)+Q\left(x^{\frac13}(y+\frac1y)+x^{\frac73}(yy+\frac{1}{yy})+x^{\frac{16}{3}}(y^4+\frac{1}{y^4})\ldots\right)$
also für $y=-\varepsilon x$
$\frac{(1-\varepsilon\varepsilon)^3[x^6]^3}{[x^2]^3}=Qx^{-\frac23}(\varepsilon-\varepsilon\varepsilon-(\varepsilon-\varepsilon\varepsilon)x\ \ldots)$
oder
$\frac{3x^{\frac23}[x^6]^3}{[x^2]^3}=Q(1-xx-x^4+x^{10}+x^{14}\ldots)=[xx]\,Q$
also
$Q=\frac{3x^{\frac23}[x^6]^3}{[xx]^4}$

Durch Entwickelung von $(x,y)(x,-y)^2$ erhält man
$P'\left(1+x^3(y^3+\frac{1}{y^3})+\right)+Q'\left(x^{\frac13}(y+\frac1y)+x^{\frac73}(yy+\frac{1}{yy})+\&c.\right.$
$(1-\varepsilon\varepsilon)(1+\varepsilon\varepsilon)^2\frac{[x^6][x^8][x^{12}]^3}{[xx][x^4]^3[x^{24}]}=Q'x^{-\frac23}(\varepsilon-\varepsilon\varepsilon)[xx]$
$Q'=-x^{\frac23}\frac{[x^6][x^8][x^{12}]^3}{[xx]^2[x^4]^3[x^{24}]}$

methods.what: Expansion of the cube of a theta-type function (x,y)^3 into two series with coefficients P and Q
Determining Q by substituting y = -εx (ε cube root of unity) and recognizing the pentagonal-type series as an infinite product
Expansion of (x,y)(x,-y)^2 with coefficients P', Q' and substitution y=-εx
